name: @wizeworks/attribution
description: Marketing attribution engine (docs/80): UTM taxonomy + controlled vocabulary, a deterministic channel classifier, and a validating campaign-link builder. The single source of truth for utm_* values across WizeWorks acquisition (L-PLAT) and tenant commerce (L-TEN) attribution. Dependency-free; consumed by sparx/apps/web + wizeworks/apps/site capture (Phase 1+) and the launch link generator (Phase 0).
